changeSet.sql: delete I from [Intersect] I inner join Asset C on I.Object = C.Object and I.ObjectID = C.ObjectID where C.ID in ( select assetid from utility.ArtifactAssetParentIntermediate group by assetid having count(assetid) > 1 ) and I.ID not in ( select max(I.ID) as IntersectID from Asset C inner join [Intersect] I on I.Object = C.Object and I.ObjectID = C.ObjectID where C.ID in ( select assetid from utility.ArtifactAssetParentIntermediate group by assetid having count(assetid) > 1 ) group by C.ID )
